recipes.name: Dad's Simple Steak Marinade
ingredients_raw: 4 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste

steps.text: Whisk together the vegetable oil, soy sauce, red wine, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic in a bowl, and pour into a resealable plastic bag.

To use the marinade, place the meat in the bag, coat with the marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours to overnight. Discard the marinade after it has been used.

raw_recipe.headline: Dad's Simple Steak Marinade
raw_recipe.description: Soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic make meats such as flank steak, skirt steak, and sirloin steaks flavorful and, most importantly, tender for the grill!

review.reviewBody: Very good! We used on sirlion & it was delish. I used red wine vinger only because I didnt have the other. Will make again!

This is pretty good for a quick marinade using ingredients that most of us probably have on hand. The only changes I made was to use olive oil instead of vegatable oil. Also added fresh lemon juice from 1 lemon. This is a good base for a marinade... but add some spices for a little bolder flavor like basil, oregano, salt & pepper, and a little cumin! Perfection!

This is the best steak marinade I have found on AR. I suggest one change. Use half the total amount of oil. Do not use all olive oil, the meat needs the vegetable oil to brown, and create the beautiful caramel color. Otherwise it is a pale gray. I used half and half olive and veg oil. Marinated just 3 hrs, beautiful especially for a lower grade of meat.

I searched through several other marinades, and they seemed too complicated. I decided on this one because it was simple and easy. 
I let my steaks sit in the marinade overnight, and it was well worth it. The flavor was impressive. They tasted so good! 
I substituted with olive oil, and I used a thick balsamic for the wine. 
The ease of soaking them in the Ziploc was great too! 
This hasn't received as many reviews as some of the others, but it will in time! I highly recommend it!
I like this recipe but prefer more time marinating.
Very, very good! I used red wine vinegar instead of red wine and my whole family loved how good our steaks came out! I am getting ready to marinade some steaks right now with this recipe.

We did not have Worcestershire (Thank god for spell correct) sauce, so I used HP instead but everything else was by the book. It was pretty darn good. I learned a trick to remove all the air from the marinading Ziploc bag by immersing the bag with the meat and marinade in it, in water which pushes all the air out. submerge until just before the closing end as you zip it shut. :)

I used this as a base recipe. Replaced veggi oil with olive oil, red wine with beef broth. Omitted the garlic. Added a dash of garlic powder, onion powder, celery salt & lemon pepper. We'll see how it comes out tomarrow. I really cant rate it cause I changed it so much. The recipe sounds great & I will have to try it as is sometime. I didn't have red wine & really didnt want to chop garlic right before going to sleep & I dont like veggi oil with meat, just tastes weird to me. I already have this recipe memorized though.

Great flavour. May be a bit too salty so next time I'll cut both the soy sauce and Worcester in half. 
Made a half recipe for 1 large steak
Such a great simple marinade! I used reduced sodium soy sauce, but made no additional changes.
Did a nice job tenderizing a sirloin steak. Flavor of the marinade was good but not over-powering.
Liked the flavor it gave the steak but was hoping it would tenderize it and it did not do that. I did not change the recipe except used white wine instead of red wine . Did not have red wine
This was so delicious! It was perfect exactly as written. Thank you so much!
This was so delicious! It was perfect exactly as written. Thank you so much!

So good, I used this to marinate an outside round roast and had great comments from my guests. Thank you for sharing..I will pass this on to my friends and just set another roast to marinate for tomorrow's Sunday dinner.
I used red wine vinegar for this, otherwise I followed the recipe exactly. I was FABULOUS!!!! Thanks Dad!
Great taste. Didn't change a thing. Made it for a tough cut of meat, marinated it for a day and the meat was so tender and Delicious. Thanks for the recipe

I used olive oil for a little bit of a healthier twist. There are better marinades on this website, but this one was fine. It helped tenderize the sirloin steaks my wife purchased. It has all of the elements for a successful marinade, but nothing that makes it stand out over and above the standard marinade. Good though.
